findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 101 requests to 25 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 7.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.7 MB (52%) came from third-party domains, 1.0 MB of it from services classified as tracking (61 requests).

14 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), googletagservices.com (Google, advertising), indexww.com (Index Exchange, advertising), kargo.com (Kargo, advertising).
14 cookies were set by third-party domains (38 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 8 requests were blocked. The page still made 101 requests to 25 third-party domains, including 14 tracking services in our list.
